title.narrative: Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Program (Tranche 3)

description.narrative: ADB and the Government of Sri Lanka are working together to improve water and wastewater management services in and around the capital city of Colombo. The Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Program (Tranche 3) is improving the efficiency and financial sustainability of water supply and wastewater services in Colombo. This includes rehabilitating the city's water supply network and reducing the amount of water that is leaked or distributed without payment. The project is rehabilitating and expanding the city's wastewater system and constructing a wastewater treatment. This is improving the quality of life for tens of thousands of residents in the greater Colombo area, including women and the poor, who will have more time for productive activities because of 24-hour water supply.

improved system efficiency and financial sustainability of water supply and wastewater services in Colombo.

NRW in Colombo city reduced to 20% (baseline: 49% in 2013) Achievement: 18 Progress/Status: Project completion extended till October 2022. The water supply system rehabilitation, expansion, and NRW reduction in northeast part of Colombo city (for Project 1) and southwest part of Colombo city southwest part of Colombo city (for Project 2) are ongoing. NRW in Colombo city reduced to 18% as per October 2022 report. Data Source: NWSDB water balance audit

Access to sewage system in south catchment area of Colombo increased to 95% by 2020 including all below poverty line households (including female headed households among them) (2012 Baseline: 65%). Achievement: To be assessed Progress/Status: Project completion extended till October 2022. Sewerage works in various stages of implementation: (i) the Kirulapone sewer contract was awarded for the rehabilitation and expansion of wastewater system in the south catchment area of Colombo; (ii) the Wellawata STP DBO contract was signed and initial designs completed.. Data Source: CMC annual reports Actual value: To be assessed

Collection of wastewater through sewage network increased by 6% by 2020 (2015 Baseline: 80%). Achievement: To be assessed Progress/Status: Project completion extended till October 2022. The Wellawata WWTP DBO contract was signed on 11 October 2021 and the works have been mobilized. Data Source: CMC annual reports Actual value: To be assessed
